definitions.explanation: A Buddhist place of worship and religious activities.

examples.japanese: {京都|きょうと}には{多|おお}くの{寺院|じいん}がある。
examples.english: There are many temples in Kyoto.

examples.japanese: {寺院|じいん}で{座禅|ざぜん}を{体験|たいけん}した。
examples.english: I experienced zazen meditation at the temple.

examples.japanese: この{寺院|じいん}は{国宝|こくほう}に{指定|してい}されている。
examples.english: This temple is designated as a national treasure.

notes:
{寺院|じいん} is a formal word for a Buddhist temple.

Common collocations:
- {仏教|ぶっきょう}{寺院|じいん} (Buddhist temple)
- {寺院|じいん}を{参拝|さんぱい}する (to visit a temple)
- {古|ふる}い{寺院|じいん} (old temple)

Related words:
- お{寺|てら} / {寺|てら} (temple - casual/common term)
- {神社|じんじゃ} (Shinto shrine)
- {境内|けいだい} (temple/shrine grounds)
- {本堂|ほんどう} (main hall of a temple)

Note: {寺院|じいん} is more formal than お{寺|てら}. In everyday conversation, お{寺|てら} is more commonly used.
